# truefoundry_secret (Resource)

Manages one secret in a TrueFoundry secret group (`truefoundry_secret_group`). Reference it from any credential attribute as `tfy-secret://${truefoundry_secret.example.fqn}`.

**The secret value is stored in the Terraform state** (marked sensitive). Use this resource for values Terraform already holds — e.g. credentials created by another resource — and keep secrets that should never touch the state out of band.

Other secrets in the same group, including ones created in the UI, are left untouched. The control plane replaces a group's whole secret list on every write, so the provider serializes writes to one group. Changing the value creates a new secret version; a value changed out of band is detected and reverted, unless the control plane hides secret values (`DISABLE_SECRET_VALUE_VIEW`).

Import a secret by its FQN, `<tenant>:<group>:<key>`: `terraform import truefoundry_secret.example my-tenant:system:vault-role-id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truefoundry_system_secret_store" "system" {
  name = "system-secret-store"

  secret_stores = [
    { name = "system-secret-store" },
  ]
}

resource "truefoundry_secret_group" "system" {
  name            = "system"
  integration_fqn = "${truefoundry_system_secret_store.system.fqn}:secret-store:system-secret-store"
}

# A Vault AppRole created by the vault provider, handed to the control plane
# without leaving Terraform. The values are stored in the Terraform state.
resource "truefoundry_secret" "vault_role_id" {
  secret_group_id = truefoundry_secret_group.system.id
  key             = "vault-role-id"
  value           = vault_approle_auth_backend_role.truefoundry.role_id
}

resource "truefoundry_secret" "vault_secret_id" {
  secret_group_id = truefoundry_secret_group.system.id
  key             = "vault-secret-id"
  value           = vault_approle_auth_backend_role_secret_id.truefoundry.secret_id
}

# Referenced from credential attributes as tfy-secret://<fqn>.
resource "truefoundry_hashicorp_account" "vault" {
  name = "vault"

  vaults = [
    {
      name          = "vault"
      vault_url     = "https://vault.example.com"
      kv_mount_path = "secret"
      approle = {
        role_id   = "tfy-secret://${truefoundry_secret.vault_role_id.fqn}"
        secret_id = "tfy-secret://${truefoundry_secret.vault_secret_id.fqn}"
      }
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Key of the secret, unique within its group. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `secret_group_id` (String) Control plane ID of the secret group holding the secret, e.g. `truefoundry_secret_group.example.id`. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the secret. Stored in the Terraform state.

### Read-Only

- `fqn` (String) Fully qualified name of the secret, `<tenant>:<group>:<key>`. Prefix it with `tfy-secret://` to reference the secret.
- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the secret.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Secrets are imported by their FQN, <tenant>:<group>:<key>. If the control
# plane hides secret values, the value is unknown after import and the next
# apply writes the configured value as a new secret version.
terraform import truefoundry_secret.vault_role_id my-tenant:system:vault-role-id
```
